CLOUD REVIEWER seat for PR #2609 of tvofi/heatpump_optimizer, at head c00082a9ae41447820af2a73c8fe4d1a2d661c8c. Bus nonce: 41dfaf10948eb8633b0941d53f4a84b3. Never send push notifications.
Setup: `git fetch --unshallow --tags origin`. The toolchain (venv python, node, gh) is on PATH from the environment. Run anything heavy in the background with Monitor and no timeout.
Role: read dev/governance/roles/fix-review.md and its rules from main, and follow them exactly. Fetch the PR head with `git fetch origin c00082a9ae41447820af2a73c8fe4d1a2d661c8c`; the PR body is in the PR. Verify each claim adversarially: mutate the fix and check the tests fail, and check every figure in the body at this head. Check that it merges with origin/main (`git merge-tree --write-tree`) and read CI on this head from the check-runs API.
Output: in a fresh directory of your own (`W=$(mktemp -d)`), write verdict.md, whose first line is exactly `Fix review: merge c00082a9ae41447820af2a73c8fe4d1a2d661c8c` or `Fix review: blocked c00082a9ae41447820af2a73c8fe4d1a2d661c8c <class>: <reason>` (no brackets; the class is lower-case letters and dashes), in the format the role file gives, then a blank line, then `bus-nonce: 41dfaf10948eb8633b0941d53f4a84b3`, then the body in sections. A blocked verdict's block goes under `## Block`. Each finding this PR does not settle (a defect, a surviving mutant, a deferral, a follow-up, a task owed after the merge) is its own bullet under `## Findings` ending in its own `Carry: <GROUP> | #<issue> | O<n> | dismissed: <reason>` (finding-propagation.md). Everything else (RESULT lines, re-runs, CI state, figures you could not re-derive) goes under `## Evidence`: tools/audit/carry_audit.py reads no item there as a finding unless it hands something on (deferred, for a later, follow-up, minor, advisory, residual, still has to, not blocking ...; a check that does not block is evidence only in the clause saying it is not a required check and does not block, never in the rest of its sentence: a nit or defect beside it is a finding), and the merge train parks a verdict holding a finding with no `Carry:`. Put the evidence files in `ev/` beside it, and make at least one file under `ev/` contain the full 40-hex head `c00082a9ae41447820af2a73c8fe4d1a2d661c8c` (e.g. `ev/HEAD.txt` holding the head you reviewed, beside your command output): bus.sh refuses a verdict whose `ev/` names no head. Do NOT run bus.sh: its dispatch record lives on the orchestrator's machine, which publishes the verdict there (cloud_relay.sh). Return the verdict on a probe ref, and push nothing else; this builds one parentless commit with a private index and touches no branch of your checkout: `R=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel); G=$(git rev-parse --absolute-git-dir); mkdir -p $W/pr && cp -r $W/verdict.md $W/ev $W/pr/ && cd $W/pr && T=$(GIT_DIR=$G GIT_INDEX_FILE=$W/idx GIT_WORK_TREE=$W/pr sh -c 'git add -A -f . && git write-tree') && C=$(GIT_DIR=$G git -c user.name=seat -c user.email=seat@users.noreply.github.com commit-tree $T -m "verdict 2609 c00082a9ae41447820af2a73c8fe4d1a2d661c8c") && git -C $R push -q origin $C:refs/heads/probe/rev-2609-41dfaf10`. That ref is the return signal. Do not post comments, approve or merge.
Never write to any branch except your return refs. Never work around a hook or a refusal; report it in your result instead.

Brief (snapshotted when this payload was rendered):
Fix reviewer, ADVERSARIAL, for PR #2609 (group R10-ARCH-DOCS-FIRST, branch fix/r10-arch-docs-first) at head c00082a9ae41447820af2a73c8fe4d1a2d661c8c, code 7ae69419e. This is the owner's priority docs delivery; a stamp follows its merge. Follow dev/governance/roles/fix-review.md from a detached worktree at the head. PREPR_SKIP_CLOSURES=1. The approved design note is dev/programme/designs/R10-ARCH-DOCS-FIRST.md, revision 2, f122a1cb5 on design/r10-arch-docs-first (design verdict: handoff-body/design-verdict-r10-arch-docs-first-r2).
Required:
1. Reproduce CI's base-pinned lane. .github/workflows/governance.yml "Restore the check source from the base commit" (decision 0013) runs policy_lint.mjs, agreement.mjs and the rest of its pinned list FROM THE BASE. Rounds 1-2 went red in CI exactly there. In a scratch worktree at the head, `git checkout origin/main -- <every pinned path the step lists>`, then run node tools/policy/policy_lint.mjs, the agreement lane as the workflow runs it (agreement_py then agreement.mjs --py-json), and the env-matrix driver. Each must be clean. Quote the RESULT lines. Also read check-runs at this head.
2. Decision O-5 (orchestrator, under mandate 6329234399):
   (a) The path-token grammar now exists once: doc_claims reuses entities.py's. Check that it is truly one definition, that agreement shows unregistered=0, and that a null control re-adding a copy brings UNREGISTERED back.
   (b) dev/README.md is in corpus_excluded with a reason. Judge the `## Raise justification`: payment 2 tried and measured, the base-pin reason, and an `Architecture score: dS` line from tools/audit/archscore/ before and after.
   (c) The policy_lint.mjs canon lookup is reverted here and carried to R10-ARCH-DOCS. Check the Forward-carry names it, and that no checker file differs from main.
   (d) The D9.md citation correction is plain text and correct.
3. The content: the owner asked for the CI and development-shape docs and figures for the PROTECTED FINAL SHAPE AT PROGRAMME END, written from the remaining plan and roster, ASAP. Check:
   - docs/architecture.md and dev/README.md against the design note's predicates (a)-(e), via doc_claims' doc_wiring_findings, with its red fixtures and null controls;
   - every mermaid block parses (dev/audit/harnesses/r10_mermaid_parse.mjs);
   - the counts are the tree's own (tests/entities.py, tests/doc_claims.py);
   - no stale path.
4. The Buy Me a Coffee button (https://buymeacoffee.com/rpgshcwb2tp):
   - It sits at the top of README.md (in-tree SVG docs/img/brand/coffee.svg), in docs/index.html's footer, and in build_docs.mjs's shared footer.
   - It follows the theme tokens.
   - No off-origin image, script, stylesheet or CSS url().
   - HACS README image rewriting is not broken (tests/entities.py).
   - coffee_button_findings has a red fixture per placement.
5. Run the mutants in dev/audit/harnesses/r10_arch_docs_first_mutants.py yourself and re-take every figure in the body at this head. A figure that differs is a finding.
6. Policy files are touched (D9.md, corpus_excluded.json). Name each policy path changed so the orchestrator can approve under the mandate.
7. git merge-tree --write-tree origin/main c00082a9ae41447820af2a73c8fe4d1a2d661c8c must be clean. ev/HEAD.txt holds the full head, and VERDICT carries bus-nonce: 41dfaf10948eb8633b0941d53f4a84b3. No /Users/ or /private/ path may appear in VERDICT.md or ev/.
Time box 60 min. A real defect blocks; a cosmetic one is a finding with a Carry to R10-ARCH-DOCS.
